ANCHOR STORIES PRE-CHECK — MORNING EDITION, WEDNESDAY 8 JULY 2026 (~10:00 BST)

Top 5 stories a competent UK editor would lead with this morning:
1. US strikes 80+ Iranian targets; Iran hits US bases in Bahrain/Kuwait; oil sanctions reinstated (BBC/Reuters/AP/WSJ — confirmed)
2. Every major party boycotts Farage's Clacton by-election (BBC/Guardian/Independent + front pages — confirmed)

5. Amber alerts live; heatwave could rival 1976; 36C possible (BBC Weather/UKHSA — confirmed)

Broad sweeps run: "world news today", "UK news today", BBC UK homepage top-5 audit (09:27 BST), Wednesday front pages.
Diary rule: Trump-Zelensky and Trump-Sharaa bilats TODAY (afternoon) — written as scheduled, not done; Khamenei burial Mashhad TOMORROW; communiqué expected today (not reported); Clacton "as early as August" attributed to Reform sources; "~20 July" Burnham handover did NOT surface today — phrased as "thirteen days from handover" only where anchored to prior 2-source verification.
Exclusions: Damascus wrap as standalone (AP single — folded a line into summit item); Gaza NCAG (AJ single, thin progress); John Lewis cuts (single, unscraped); student loans committee report (single — parliament.uk not fetched); Harry "whitewash" fallout (via Star front page only — held); Kyiv toll reconciliation (used "at least 21 killed Monday" per Guardian where needed... final text uses zero-of-23 intercept stat and "third attack in a week" without re-litigating tolls); London 34C Tuesday claim (unapproved — used verified 32.4C Teddington/Frittenden); ALL World Cup content (sport — vetoed).
Single-source-plus-official items: Starmer £37bn missile programme (BBC + No 10 official release), Virgin Media fine (BBC + Ofcom official).
Timestamps forced to Europe/London (system clock still Reykjavik/GMT).
